import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {fahrenheit} from './convert.mjs';import {available} from './stock.mjs';import {shipping} from './shipping.mjs';

import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {createApp} from './handlers.mjs';
test('combined HTTP contract',async()=>{const app=createApp();await new Promise(r=>app.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',r));try{const r=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:'+app.address().port,{method:'POST',headers:{Connection:'close'},body:JSON.stringify({celsius:20,total:12,reserved:5,subtotal:14,delivery:3})});assert.equal(r.status,200);assert.deepEqual(await r.json(),{fahrenheit:68,available:7,shipping:17});}finally{app.closeAllConnections();await new Promise(r=>app.close(r));}});
